description.text:
Blade Awakening (利刃猛醒) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 16 January 2026 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. It brought more than 200 new cards with regulation mark H, which arrived in the Chinese game with it, and from the same day the Standard format allowed only cards marked F, G and H, plus the eight basic Energy. It has a Terastallized Greninja ex and more Tera Pokémon ex, and more Ancient and Future cards, among them Gouging Fire ex, Raging Bolt ex, Walking Wake ex, Iron Leaves ex, Iron Crown ex and Iron Boulder ex. Its ACE SPEC cards, of which a deck may hold only one, include Master Ball, Prime Catcher, Hero's Cape, Maximum Belt and Neo Upper Energy, and its Supporters include Lucian, Salvatore, Eri, Bianca's Devotion and Morty's Conviction.

The Blade Awakening coin set (利刃猛醒硬币套装) came out the same day: three 5-card packs, one of 30 chosen holos (five Pokémon ex and 25 Common, Uncommon or Rare Pokémon, which came in Poké Ball pattern or, one time in a hundred, Master Ball pattern) and a coin of that Pokémon, in one of two regular styles or a rare gold one. Pokémon China noted that the Iron Thorns cards 090/204 and 206/204 word part of their attack's name differently but count as the same attack. Its main cards are numbered out of 204; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 259.
